versions.changelog:
Initial release: Powerful Xiaohongshu data mining and public note search tool.

- Enables keyword search, note details & comments lookup, creator work list retrieval, and structured data for trend or competition analysis.
- No login required; supports up to 10,000 results with robust filtering and export features.
- Four main capabilities: keyword search, note detail fetch, creator posts monitoring, and note comments extraction.
- Clear input, error-handling, and output principles to ensure accurate, actionable results.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
